control_timeline.detail: run 2026-11-14T213143Z_kaden-vandine_flightgear-connectome. Neurons decide: pitch (jump/rotation, flare), steering and roll through descending-neuron rates (DNp01/02/04/11, DNp07, DNp15, DNa02, DNp20, MN9). Code decides: synthetic runway/path and known-obstacle sensory encoding of aircraft state, the fixed decoder from DN rates to controls, the behavioural-state gate (standing/flying), a fixed-gain pitch-rate reflex (haltere stand-in), speed-dependent ground steering limits/yaw damping, stale-decision rejection, a fixed flare pitch envelope (no pitch-up once the sink is arrested), landing thrust to idle in the flare (MN9 sets approach power only above it), and phase handover (flies.py); takeoff_live holds the parking brake while the brain calibrates and releases it at the handover
